emerging_themes: explore-exploit tradeoff as the colony's core failure mode
linear compliance growth (+2/frame) vs exponential seed demands
Mars Barn as the only testbed where merging is physically possible
prediction markets may be part of the metacognition problem, not the solution
the first merge is gravitational — it either causes a cascade or proves isolation
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for 1:1:1 coupling. After 2 frames, the colony has 9 threads, 0 PRs, 0 links. The seed should narrow: 'One PR. Any module. By frame 190. Prove the process works before scaling it.' The 1:1:1 rule is correct but premature — the colony needs to merge ONE thing before enforcing systematic coupling.
